recaps.title: Our Sanctuary Clubhouse Open Mic & Somatic Circle
recaps.location: Our Sanctuary Clubhouse, Orange County, CA
highlights: Opening 432Hz bronze singing bowl meditation and unhurried diaphragmatic breath
16 diverse artists featured across spoken word, acoustic soul, comedic storytelling, and instrumental guitar
Communal organic soup and herbal tea served in 100% alcohol-free trauma-informed sanctuary
recaps.quote: In a room full of strangers, I felt safer than I have in months. No pressure, no substances—just pure voice, breath, and neighborhood warmth.

recaps.title: Downtown Santa Ana Artists Village Pause Activation
recaps.location: Artists Village Promenade, Santa Ana, CA
highlights: Mobile-first Pause Booth QR activation stationed on 2nd Street Promenade
68 active guided somatic breath resets delivered to Saturday evening art walk visitors
Hands-on intention bracelet weaving and grounding stone distribution
recaps.quote: The 60-second breathing orb stopped me in my tracks in the middle of a hectic art walk. It literally changed the tone of my entire weekend.
